meta.title: Try it at COSI
meta.summary: Hey, at COSI you can test a question with your own hands. I want to see what you try first.

blocks.text: At COSI’s Gadgets exhibit, you can build a model bridge, test how it holds up, and try a pulley chair to explore simple machines. I’d start with the bridge: tension, compression, and torque make much more sense when your own design is doing the balancing. If the first version needs work, that’s a better question for your next try.

The Ocean exhibit takes us in another direction, with a wave tank and activities about water’s behavior. One visit can jump from engineering to moving water without leaving Columbus. I’d check the current exhibits, pick a question that grabs us, and leave time to experiment. You get to choose what we try first. I like an exhibit that lets a question turn into something you can try. You choose first; I’m curious what will surprise you. ♡
